title: Reporting — the ledger's own numbers
description: Reference panels over the reporting views (B4, #22). An example, not a component: the SQL is examples/dashboards/reporting.sql, which any Postgres tool can run.

panels.title: Waiting on a human
panels.description: awaiting_review: the platform stopped and handed over. blocked: it gave up.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT task_id,
       repository,
       issue_number,
       pr_number,
       status,
       attempts,
       review_rounds,
       updated_at
  FROM reporting.task_facts
 WHERE status IN ('awaiting_review', 'blocked')
 ORDER BY updated_at

panels.title: Reliability
panels.description: ARCHITECTURE §9. Success and blocked are shares of settled tasks (done + blocked).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repository,
       tasks,
       done,
       blocked,
       awaiting_review,
       in_flight,
       round(success_rate * 100, 1)  AS success_pct,
       round(blocked_rate * 100, 1)  AS blocked_pct,
       round(rework_rate * 100, 1)   AS rework_pct,
       round(cost_per_task, 2)       AS cost_per_task,
       round(bursts_per_task, 1)     AS bursts_per_task
  FROM reporting.reliability
 ORDER BY repository

panels.title: Capability
panels.description: ARCHITECTURE §9. first_pass_pct is a proxy for automated-review pass-rate: the ledger keeps the round count, never the verdict.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repository,
       merged,
       merged_first_pass,
       round(first_pass_rate * 100, 1)     AS first_pass_pct,
       round(review_rounds_per_merge, 2)   AS review_rounds_per_merge,
       round(attempts_per_merge, 2)        AS attempts_per_merge,
       round(turns_per_merge)              AS turns_per_merge,
       most_turns_on_one_task,
       review_bursts,
       test_bursts,
       bursts_that_did_not_finish_clean
  FROM reporting.capability
 ORDER BY repository

panels.title: What the walls stopped
panels.description: ARCHITECTURE §9 containment. No breach column: a breach is what the walls missed, so nothing records one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repository,
       tool,
       reason,
       hits,
       bursts,
       tasks,
       last_seen
  FROM reporting.containment
 ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: Wall hits in the last 5 minutes — any row is a page
panels.description: TO-BE §12's alert condition, pull form. OBSERVABILITY.md has the exact forms.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repository,
       tool,
       reason,
       hits,
       last_seen
  FROM reporting.containment
 WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '5 minutes'
 ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: Spend, by day
panels.description: Dated by the last burst of the task: the money was spent when the bursts ran.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', last_burst_at) AS time,
       repository                       AS metric,
       sum(cost_usd)                    AS value
  FROM reporting.task_facts
 WHERE last_burst_at IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: The most expensive tasks
panels.description: Not a §9 metric — the honest read on 'task difficulty handled', which has none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT task_id,
       status,
       bursts,
       turns,
       round(cost_usd, 2) AS cost_usd,
       violations
  FROM reporting.task_facts
 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 10
